$comment: Where You Stand — the state system.
Every interpretive sentence the product shows is selected by an exact
arithmetic condition. This file holds those conditions and the copy slot
each one selects. It carries identifiers and numbers only: no prose lives
Thresholds signed off by the author, 30 August 2026, as written in the
review's section 9. They are frozen. Changing one is a decision, not a
tweak: every sentence in copy.json was written to be true at its own band.

thresholds.$comment: Points are percentage points a year unless said otherwise.

$comment: Tool 3. Nine cells: how the reader's own speed compares with the fund's
over the same dates, crossed with where that stretch sits in the fund's
whole record. One cell fires. Each carries a sentence and a next step.
Axis one, the gap: the reader's XIRR against the fund's speed over the
reader's exact dates, at the half-point band.
Axis two, the placement: the fund's speed over those dates, ranked among
every window of the same length in days, at the quartiles.

overrides.effect: the yearly rate is withheld; the total is shown; no cell fires
printed above the cell, which still fires

$comment: The even-drip twin fires only when the reader's own dates carry a
story: a purchase above three times the median instalment, or a gap
longer than two months. Purchases only. Otherwise it prints nothing.

extra.condition: latest NAV below the NAV twelve months earlier
a single purchase inside the last 12 months worth 40% or more of all money in

thisFundsRecord.$comment: Tool 2. One state line on the index-fund comparison, at one point.

guards.condition: history shorter than one full window

$slotInventory: The eighteen Tool 3 slots the author is writing, in the order the review
names them: nine cell sentences with their nine next steps, two overrides,
three replay lines, two drip lines, and the falling-market and recent-lump
lines. Each is addressable by the id above and by nothing else, so wording
can change without touching a line of code.
